Naiṣadhānanda
drama. by Śrīnivāsācārya mentioned in his C. on Abhijñānaśākuntala. TCD. 1259A.

Naiṣadhānanda
drama in 7 acts. on the life of Nala an. Damayantī. by Kṣemīśvara. Peters. III. Extr. p.. 340-42. Being edited by A. K. Warder an. D.. K. K. Raja. on the basis of two Mss. from Bikaner an. Jodhpur.

Naiṣadhīyacarita
or Naiṣadha. mahākāvya in 22 cantos. on the story of Nala an. Damayantī based on the Mahābhārata episode (upto the marriage). by Śrīharṣa, [Page230-a. son of Śrīhīra an. Māmalladevī; patronized by the King of Kānyakubja; in the 12th century; included among the best five Mahākāvyas (Pañcamahākāvyas) according to tradition. For a. attempt to complete the story see Uttaranaiṣadha by Mādhava.
See K. K. Handiqui, Naiṣadhacarita. English translation. Poona, 1956; A. N. Jani, A Critical Study of Śrīharṣa's Naiṣadhīyacaritam, Baroda, 1957; P. Bandhyopadhyaya, Observations on Similes in the Naiṣadhīyacarita, Calcutta, 1966; also N. P. Unni, Nala Episode in Sanskrit Literature, Trivandrum, 1977.
See also M. B. Emeneau, Notes on Śrīharṣa's Naiṣadhacarita, Semitic an. Oriental Studies, p.. 87-102. Berkley, 1951; Sivaprasada Bhattacharya, “The Naiṣadhīyacarita an. its Bearing on the Alaṅkāra Code”, Gode Com. Vol. Part III. p.. 19-35.
For a study on the Naiṣadhīyacarita in Malayalam see P. K. Kurup, Cannanore, 1952.
